Support

Textbound Adventures is still in development. This page is the stable home for support information as the game approaches release.

Testing a build?

If you received the game through TestFlight, please send feedback through the TestFlight app. That includes the build and device details needed to investigate most problems.

Before reporting a problem

  1. Check that you have the latest available build.
  2. Close and reopen Textbound Adventures.
  3. Include the adventure name, what you tried, and what happened.

Public support contact

A public contact address will be added here before the App Store release. No unverified address is being published in the meantime.
